meaning: Five-input source-free composition. At an accessible world v failing full headless-ancestry coverage, import HeadlessCausalAncestry.source_of_not_headless_coverage on existing actualGraph and actualSource_iff to obtain one existing source c under the supplied Ontic.Causes relation. If this SAME c were absent at any successor of v, LocalCausalPrinciple would provide an existing cause at v, contradicting sourcehood. Explicit EM gives NecessaryAt m v c. Euclidean sibling access transports its existence to every successor of the selected world w; actual reflexivity supplies access from v back to w, giving actual existence there too. The sameSource helper preserves v,c, sourcehood ONLY at v and necessity at both worlds; project its SAME c to the existing NecessaryBeing conclusion. No boxed de dicto G-necessitation, transitivity, universal frame, WF, acyclicity, choice function, population or causation-grounding bridge is assumed. Existing global LocalCausalPrinciple has stronger scope and distinctness than needed; no minimality or weaker-overall-bundle claim. All five inputs remain explicit; no metaphysical premise discharged. The branching-network opportunity is not attributed to survey A2, and its source-chain correspondence, intended concrete/capable domain and real modal availability remain open. No concreteness, causal capability, sourcehood at w, unique root, intrinsic explanatory adequacy or divine attribute follows.
